verdict.rationale: Shopify documents multiple official, first-party UCP-compliant MCP servers: Global Catalog, Storefront Catalog, Cart, Checkout, and Order, each with named tools and auth tiers. Runtime probes confirmed live JSON-RPC initialize handshakes at catalog.shopify.com/api/ucp/mcp and a storefront's /api/ucp/mcp, plus a real keyless cart creation. Access is tiered: Checkout requires auth or signed requests, and Order MCP is Token-tier only. Missing for 10: hands-on verification of the authenticated Checkout and Order MCP tiers, and independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs and probes.
